method: Six fixed seeds (1–6), standard and veteran mirrors, open/ridges/canyons, 720-second observation cap. Research completion sampled each second. Capped running games are not wins or draws. This is a content-usage smoke, not a full balance guardrail sweep.
finding: The initial candidate completed no research: two-live-bomber and spare-funds gates starved it. The final candidate prioritizes a shared-queue research reservation after a baseline screen holds an island.
integrationNote: Controlled comparison predates the subsequent Designations master merge; final integration checks are reported separately.
